svg.title: WITH RECURSIVE chain — inline anchor, upward org traversal
svg.desc: Two-column schematic: left shows the single-CTE structure with anchor and recursive step inside chain, then the final SELECT. Right shows the upward traversal from anchor IC at level 0 through manager to VP/Director.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the anchor member of the chain CTE do, and what is the risk of LIMIT 1 without ORDER BY?')
sendPrompt('How does the recursive step in chain follow manager_id upward?')
sendPrompt('What does the final SELECT return from chain, and why is no LIMIT needed?')
sendPrompt('How does the chain recursion know when to stop climbing?')
sendPrompt('What is level 1 in the chain traversal?')
sendPrompt('What is the anchor IC at level 0 in the chain CTE?')
